dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a concave spline with three distinct discontinuities, including one large rectangular notch on the lower third and two smaller nicks superior to it.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is broadly rounded with a large pixel radius; classification is obtuse-rounded.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents as a nearly straight diagonal line at a steep angle of approximately 60 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the visible base width to the maximum vertical height is approximately 1.3:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple notches on the trailing edge (one large rectangular indentation and two smaller V-shaped nicks); extensive white punctate lesions or scarring distributed across the lower and central lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of high-contrast white spots near the lower trailing edge, along with a larger circular depigmented region near the posterior base.
